in growing CSAM thematic equities into one of the best thematic equity boutiques globally. Prior to that co-manager of all global equity funds at Mirabaud Asset Management and all global equity funds at Aviva Investors. Technology expert with PhD in semiconductor physics from Cambridge. PhD thesis "Induced Quantum Wires". Undergraduate and M.Sc. degree in laser physics and engineering. Former global technology analyst and strategy management consultant in the Technology, Media and Telecom [...] technology through advocacy, partnership, grants and venture investing. Member of the Board’s Investments and Ventures Committees. Sustainability champion. Former lead manager of an impact-aligned fund with the highest sustainability classification from the EU (Article 9 SFDR). Author of the first ever Impact and Engagement fund report at
